# TRAVNY full documentation

Source: https://trfny.com/

Description: Complete LLM-oriented map of the public TRAVNY web services.

## TRAVNY hub

The canonical hub is https://trfny.com/. It groups public TV, weather, feed and browser-tool projects. `travny.pages.dev` is an emergency noindex fallback; `tvpi.pages.dev` redirects to the canonical host.

### TVPI

The TV page is https://trfny.com/tv/. Stable playlist endpoints are served from https://tvpi.trfny.com/. The combined playlist is `/playlist.m3u`; per-channel `.m3u8` endpoints are stable URLs that resolve or serve fresh HLS manifests. Do not persist short-lived upstream tokenized URLs as durable endpoints.

### Weather

https://weather.trfny.com/ combines multiple weather sources for Koscielec in Chrzanow and publishes current state JSON plus Atom feeds for weather changes and IMGW warnings.

### Feedseek

https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/ publishes enhanced Atom/RSS feeds, JSON Feed 1.1 sidecars, OPML, a browser Reader and source-aware WebMCP tools where supported.

### Streambench

https://streambench.trfny.com/ is a local-first IPTV/radio/HLS/M3U/XMLTV workshop. Local playlists, edits and history remain in the browser; constrained public provider APIs support the catalog UI.

### Code Bench

https://codebench.trfny.com/ creates, styles and scans QR codes and barcodes. User payloads are processed in browser state.

### Doc Bench

https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/ edits text/structured documents and performs PDF operations locally in the browser, including merge, page work, bookmarks and optimization.
